login.note: Email + password, with Google and X as alternatives. Historically an emailed sign-in link is offered too, and that link opens a session in whichever browser handles it — which must be this one. No SSO redirect chain for the email path, so the share can usually be closed as soon as the feed renders.

logout.note: Behind the avatar menu in the header; not present in the DOM until the menu is opened. Selector is a hypothesis — confirm it against the live shell before relying on it.

traps: The whole site reads fine while signed out — feed, posts, comments, milestones. There is no content difference to detect a session by; only the header controls and the composer change.
The session cookie is HttpOnly, so document.cookie is blind to it on a live session.

'/api/v3/me' in this probe is an UNVERIFIED guess at the who-am-I endpoint. It is written to fall through silently on 404/HTML rather than to conclude anything, so a wrong path costs nothing — but do not read a green verdict from that layer until a live run has confirmed the path exists.
notes: PROBE STRATEGY: three layers, each falling through quietly rather than concluding. (a) '__NEXT_DATA__' walked for a currentUser/viewer node — the app's own boot state is the cheapest honest answer. (b) a credentialed same-origin fetch of a who-am-I endpoint, where the verdict is the presence of the username/id FIELD and never the 200: a wrong path answers 200 with HTML, and JSON.parse plus the field check are what catch that. (c) the DOM — a /@handle link or the dashboard/new-post control in the nav. Cookies are never consulted (see traps). A READ RECIPE should fetch the site's own JSON feed endpoint (the one the client calls for the home/latest stream) rather than scraping cards, and should carry the post id so a follow-up can pull a thread; until that is captured, read.verb stays 'eval' against the home fixture. WRITE is empty: posting and commenting exist but no reviewed, rate-aware path has been proven here, and IndieHackers is a small community where an automated post is noticed.
probe_checked: positive path PROVEN live 2026-09-12: ran in the fork against a signed-in session and returned signed_in. It returns no `as` — the nav-link branch names nobody, so identity is still unproven.
